facts.statement: Adzhosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform belonging to the family Shartegosuchidae.
facts.quote: Adzhosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform in the family Shartegosuchidae.

facts.statement: Fossils of Adzhosuchus were discovered in southwestern Mongolia.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from southwestern Mongolia that date back to the Late Jurassic period.

facts.statement: Adzhosuchus lived during the Late Jurassic period.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from southwestern Mongolia that date back to the Late Jurassic period.

facts.statement: The genus Adzhosuchus was described by Efimov and colleagues in 2000.
Adzhosuchus lived between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago during the Tithonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Tithonian (149.2 to 143.1 million years ago)
